Subject: CAIQ intake for Oakridge Systems

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on — Oakridge is preparing to start a CAIQ-based intake this month as part of our vendor security review. We're hoping to run a short kickoff (30–45m) to align scoping and confirm evidence owners.

High-level asks up front:
- Confirm Redwood's CAIQ point of contact and available kickoff windows next week.
- Initial list of artifacts we should expect (network diagrams, KMS/key management details, simple log retention statement).
- Any preferred transfer method for larger artifacts (SFTP/SharePoint/Drive).

I've attached our initial CAIQ spreadsheet with the sections we care about highlighted (attachment: Oakridge_CAIQ_Initial.xlsx).

Proposed times: Tue 4/16 9–11am PT or Wed 4/17 1–3pm PT — open to other slots if needed.

Appreciate it,
Sam Cho
Security Program Manager
Oakridge Systems

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2024-04-10T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake for Oakridge Systems

Hi Sam — thanks for sending this over and for the proposed windows. We can definitely run a kickoff and triage the initial asks.

I'm available Tue 4/16 10:00–10:45am PT and Wed 4/17 1:30–2:15pm PT — happy to take whichever works best for your team. Tentative agenda below:

1) Introductions & scope (5m)
2) CAIQ sections Oakridge flagged / clarifying questions (15m)
3) Evidence handoff methods and short list of priority artifacts (10m)
4) Owners & next steps / timeline (10m)

Priority artifacts we'll ask for during intake (so we can route internally):
- Logical/network diagram showing VPCs, peering, egress paths (PDF/PNG)
- Key management description + KMS diagram (KMS vendor and whether keys are customer-managed)
- Log retention policy and a sample log export (if possible)
- SOC 2 status (report or timeline)

We typically accept SFTP or a secure share link for larger files — I'll provide an upload target if Oakridge prefers SFTP. I've attached a short prep checklist to help Oakridge prioritize items (attachment: redwood-caiq-prep-checklist.pdf).

CCing Marissa (security success) and Monica (eng lead) who will own evidence coordination on our side.

If that slot looks good please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-caiq-prep-checklist.pdf (pdf)
